quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q Q2 2026 (three months ended July 4, 2026) end-market and channel detail: Compute and Communications revenue $125,944 thousand, 62.6% of revenue, versus $68,664 thousand (55.4%) a year earlier; Industrial and Embedded $75,135 thousand (37.4%) versus $55,307 thousand. Distributors were 95% of Q2 revenue ($190,914 thousand) versus 84% a year earlier, and Greater China (ship-to) was 67% of revenue ($134,282 thousand) versus 52%. GAAP gross margin was 70.3%. As of July 4, 2026 Lattice had no significant long-term commitments for capital expenditures.
